newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to move lower, target 126.97.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to move lower, target 126.97.

text.p: June BTPs will slide on Monday to target 126.97 ahead of a possible move down to 126.32, technical analysts said.
And in the medium term the contract may plumb new contract lows below 123.60.
"I think we've seen a medium term top at 129.05," said Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch here.
"Over the long term I'm looking for a break of 125.94 which would be the initial move on the correction, or wave one in Elliott Wave terms."
By 0752 GMT the June BTP was down 44 basis points at 127.32.
He said initial support for the contract would kick in at 126.97, the 38 percent retracement of the rally from 123.60 on March 18 to 129.05 on April 17.
"After that I'm looking for 126.32 over the short term," said Wilkin. "But over the medium term I'm looking to go through 125.94 to confirm losses though the contract low of 123.60."
On the upside, Wilkin said there was an area of congestion around 128.00, then resistance at last Friday's high of 128.26.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Markets, agreed short term rallies were likely to struggle over 128.00.
"Against the bearish picture such action offers selling opportunities with stops placed over 128.52," he said in a note.
Adcock said he was looking for a test of supports maybe as far at 126.50 over the slightly longer term.
By 0812 GMT, June Eurolira was down three basis points at 93.09. Adcock said the contract had broken down through trendline support, highlighting the potential for a more prolonged corrective phase.
"Against this background we use short term rallies as a selling opportunity looking for tests and more than likely breaks of the 92.92 lows," said Adcock.
